assertion: It’s the biggest win for either party in 50 years, since after Watergate.
inaccuracy: The article says 14 points exceeds everything in 50 years; 1976 was 14.1 (Brookings) to 14.3 (warehouse), equal or larger.
sql: SELECT year, 100.0*(SUM(CASE WHEN party_major='D' THEN candidate_votes ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN party_major='R' THEN candidate_votes ELSE 0 END))/SUM(candidate_votes) margin FROM officials.house_election_results WHERE stage='gen' AND special=false AND uncontested=false AND candidate_kind='candidate' GROUP BY year
